description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'tlFilterControl' used in the TestLink project for managing GUI-level filtering logic for test cases and requirements. It includes constants, properties, constructor and destructor methods, and several abstract methods for subclasses to implement specific filter behaviors and tree building functionalities.

classes.name: tlFilterControl
classes.description: An abstract class providing common filtering logic at the GUI level for the TestLink project, extended by specific filter panels for test cases and requirements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter control, reading configuration and user input, setting filter modes and labels.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up object references after use.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Reads filter-related configuration options, such as string options for select inputs.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Loads user input and request parameters to initialize filter control state.

methods.name: init_filter_custom_fields
methods.description: Initializes custom filter fields based on configuration and user input.

methods.name: init_advanced_filter_mode
methods.description: Sets the filter mode to advanced or simple based on configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Abstract method; to be implemented in subclasses to initialize settings.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Abstract method; to be implemented in subclasses to initialize filters.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Abstract method; to be implemented in subclasses to retrieve active filters.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Abstract method; to be implemented in subclasses to build a JavaScript tree menu for GUI.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Abstract method; to be implemented in subclasses to fetch custom fields.
